ev.q: CDC released nifurtimox to 336 patients, 34.2% of whom were in California.
Among 243 treated patients reporting information about adverse events, 91.4% (222 of 243) experienced at least one adverse event.
Approximately one half of patients were female (58.9%; 196 of 333) and most identified as Hispanic (93.2%; 290 of 311).
The state with the highest number of patients for whom drug was released was California (115; 34.2%)
Most adverse events were reported for the following categories: gastrointestinal (68.7%), neurologic (60.5%), and constitutional (46.5%).

methods_quotes.q: Fisher’s exact test was used to assess statistical significance (p<0.05).
